mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawl_raw_card ( issuer_id, external_card_code, card_name, source_url, raw_text, content_hash, fetched_at ) VALUES ( #{issuerId}, #{externalCardCode}, #{cardName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{rawText}, #{contentHash}, #{fetchedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE card_name = VALUES(card_name), source_url = VALUES(source_url), raw_text = VALUES(raw_text), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)
